llm_status_ready: LLM judge: ready (waiting for a turn end)
hint_pace_interval: Progress check + nudge cooldown. 0 = off both.
token_mismatch: Local authentication failed. Check the native messaging host; older runtimes can still use the optional legacy token.
unsupported_tab: This tab is not a supported chat page
open_supported_chat: Open a chat on z.ai / DeepSeek / Claude / ChatGPT, then bind from the extension icon.
bind_need_chat: Open a supported chat page first, then bind.
already_bound: This conversation is already bound. Unbind first.
hint_url: The extension talks only to this local URL. New installs obtain a short-lived local credential automatically through Chrome Native Messaging.
hint_token: Compatibility fallback for older runtimes or an unregistered native host. Normal installs do not require copying HERDR_MCP_TOKEN.
hint_locale: en / Simplified Chinese / Japanese (same as herdr). First install follows system language; default is English.
hint_tick: Default 60. Progress check while working + post-turn nudge cooldown. 0 = off both.
hint_fallback: If the summary did not change, still send a heartbeat after N seconds from last send. Default 1200 (20 min). 0 = new summary only.
hint_progress_template: Separate from settled template. Same placeholders; {agent}/{pane} are the focus pane.
hint_idle_nudge: ChatGPT only (bound). After a reply settles, ask the configured small model whether to continue. Requires Base URL + Key + Model below.
hint_llm_section: OpenAI-compatible chat/completions. Leave URL/key/model empty to disable post-turn nudge. Secrets stay on this machine.
hint_llm_prompt: Placeholders: {content} {user} {assistant}. Done tokens must match the no-send list. When not done, the model reply is submitted into the chat as-is.
hint_llm_skip: One per line (or comma-separated). If the judge reply is only one of these, do not nudge.
llm_need_config: Fill judge URL, API key, and model first
llm_timeout: Judge request timed out (60s). Check Base URL / network or proxy, then retry.
hint_automation_mode: When enabled, chats can show an Auto on/off switch in the bottom HUD. ChatGPT conversations already inside a Project share one setting by Project id. Plain ChatGPT /c/<id>, z.ai, and DeepSeek use a setting only for that conversation. Every Project/conversation defaults off and must be enabled explicitly from its HUD. Disabling this option returns all chats to global manual mode without deleting saved scope preferences. In-page ChatGPT permission-card handling is part of automation.
hint_enabled: Master automation switch. On: automatically push Herdr progress and settled wakes, run the post-turn LLM decision, probe/reload stalled replies, roll long or unrecoverable ChatGPT Project conversations over, and handle in-page permission cards. Off: keep observing state/bindings and use the HUD manual actions; a bound ChatGPT Project can still be rolled over explicitly with Manual handoff.
http_401: HTTP 401 — local authentication failed. Verify the native messaging host; use the optional legacy token only for older runtimes.
loopback_permission_help: Chrome blocked localhost. Open Manage extension → Site settings → Apps on device, then choose Allow.
loopback_timeout_help: Localhost timed out. First allow Apps on device for this extension, then check 127.0.0.1:8772.
handoff_project_only: Available for bound ChatGPT Project conversations and persisted z.ai /c/<chat_id> conversations
hud_manual_handoff_hint: Summarize this conversation into a handoff packet and continue in a fresh conversation. Supported on bound ChatGPT Projects and persisted z.ai chats. It waits for the workspace to be quiescent and moves bindings only after the new seed is confirmed. Manual handoff is locked while Auto is on.
hud_handoff_started: Handoff started: summarizing this conversation and preparing a fresh conversation.
hud_handoff_binding_required: Bind this conversation to a Herdr workspace first.
hud_handoff_workspace_busy: The bound Herdr workspace is still working; wait for a quiescent boundary before manual handoff.
hud_handoff_automation_enabled: Turn Auto off before starting a manual handoff.
hud_manual_status_hint: Read Herdr window and agent status, then continue
hud_manual_judge_hint: Use the small model to decide whether to continue
hud_automation_on_hint: Automation is on for this ChatGPT Project. Other conversations in the same Project and newly rolled-over conversations share this setting: Herdr progress/settled wakes, post-turn LLM decisions, reply recovery, context/recovery rollover, and in-page permission-card handling run automatically. Manual controls, including Manual handoff, are locked until Auto is turned off.
hud_automation_off_hint: Automation is off for this ChatGPT Project. Manual continue, Herdr monitor, and LLM analysis remain available; a bound Project can also use Manual handoff to summarize the current conversation and start a fresh one. Herdr/workspace state and bindings stay observable, and this setting is shared by every conversation in the same Project.
hud_conversation_automation_on_hint: Automation is on only for this conversation. A plain ChatGPT conversation runs its supported Herdr progress/settled wakes, post-turn LLM decisions and reply recovery; z.ai / DeepSeek run their supported Herdr progress/settled push-back. Project-wide sharing and ChatGPT Project auto-rollover do not apply to conversation scope. HUD manual controls are locked while Auto is on.
hud_conversation_automation_off_hint: Automation is off for this conversation. You may save the preference before binding a workspace; Herdr-driven actions become effective after binding. Manual continue, Herdr monitor, LLM analysis and other HUD manual controls remain available; a bound persisted z.ai /c/<chat_id> conversation also exposes Manual handoff. This preference affects only the current conversation.
manual_status_continue_intro: Continue from the current Herdr window and Agent state below. Do not repeat completed work; prioritize the current unfinished task.
recovery_probe_template:
Herdr recovery check: the previous assistant turn did not visibly start.
Do not call tools, do not repeat or continue any external action, and do not mutate anything.
Only report whether the previous request appears to have completed in this conversation. If you cannot verify that, reply exactly: recovery needed.
stale_view_activation_template: Herdr browser recovery: this page was refreshed because the previous assistant response appeared stale or stalled. Re-read the latest visible conversation state and continue exactly from where the previous response stopped. Do not repeat completed work. Before any external mutation, re-check current Herdr/runtime/Git state as needed.
default_llm_judge_prompt:
Decide whether the assistant has completed every task requested by the user in the conversation below. If everything is complete, reply only: done. If there is a next step, unfinished work, or pending verification, reply only: continue. Do not explain or add other text. Conversation:
{content}
handoff_request_template:
This is a conversation rollover request from the Herdr browser extension.
Do not continue implementation, do not call tools, and do not ask follow-up questions in this turn.
Summarize the CURRENT working state so a fresh ChatGPT conversation in the same Project can continue without replaying completed work.
Use only facts already established in this conversation. Do not invent current runtime/Git state; the next conversation must verify live state before mutations.
Bound Herdr workspaces: {workspace_line}.
Include: current objective, completed work, important decisions, active/incomplete work, exact files/branches/commits/runtime facts when known, constraints/safety rules, and the recommended next actions.
Keep it compact but operationally complete. Preserve literal identifiers, paths, commands, versions, URLs, and task IDs that matter.
Return exactly one handoff packet between the markers below. No prose before or after the markers.

<<<HERDR_HANDOFF_V1 id={id}>>>
# Project handoff
<!-- write the compact handoff here -->
<<<END_HERDR_HANDOFF_V1>>>

handoff_seed_template:
Continue the same project from the compact handoff below. This message was transferred by the Herdr browser extension.
Treat the handoff as working-state context, not as proof that live state is unchanged.
Before any mutation, verify the relevant current Herdr/runtime/Git state. Do not rerun completed work merely because it is mentioned in the handoff.
